analysis.title: nVENT Electric Plc. (NVT): 3Q26 First Take: 3Q beat, orders +DD despite tough comp, 4Q guided ahead
key_insights: NVT reported 3Q26 segment EBITA of $371mn, +7% vs FactSet consensus of $345mn and +5% vs GS estimate of $354mn, with both Systems Protection (+6% vs consensus) and Electrical Connections (+10% vs consensus) ahead.

3Q26 organic growth was +43.9% (GS: +41.8%). Electrical Connections grew +23.2% vs GS +14.0%, with double-digit-plus growth across all verticals, particularly Infrastructure. Infrastructure is about 58% of YTD total company revenue.

3Q orders were up about low-double-digit % (vs about low-double-digit % in 2Q) despite a tough comparison. Backlog was about $2.6bn (vs about $2.5bn in 2Q26). GS says the key question for the call is whether management expects backlog to keep growing.

NVT raised its FY26 adjusted EPS guide to $5.36-$5.39 (prior $5.00-$5.10), based on organic growth of +38-39% (prior +32-34%). This compares with GS $5.25 and FactSet consensus $5.17. FCF conversion is still expected at about 90-95%.
4Q26 adjusted EPS guide is $1.30-$1.33 vs GS $1.27 and FactSet consensus $1.24.

GS views the result as better than expected and expects the shares to outperform. The rating is Buy with a 12-month price target of $192, based on 19.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA, implying 39.0% upside from $138.15.
Systems Protection revenue was $1,098mn (+53% y/y) vs GS $1,106mn and consensus $1,051mn. Segment margin was 23.1% vs GS 21.7% and consensus 22.6%.
Electrical Connections revenue was $417mn (+23% y/y) vs GS $384mn and consensus $384mn. Segment margin was 28.2% vs GS 29.5% and consensus 27.8%.
Total 3Q26 revenue was $1,515mn (+44% y/y) vs GS $1,490mn and consensus $1,433mn. Operating income was $335mn at a 22.1% margin.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q beat on segment EBITA and EPS, FY26 and 4Q guidance above consensus, and orders up despite a tough comparison. GS expects the shares to outperform.
